items.headline: Albemarle Upgrade: Can Energy Storage Recharge Lithium's Leader?
items.snippet: On Oct. 14, Mizuho's John Roberts upgraded the lithium giant to Outperform from Neutral with a $130 price target, citing booming demand for battery energy storage systems. Albemarle reports third-quarter results on Nov. 4.

items.headline: Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat
items.snippet: For Albemarle, price matters more than volume. In the second quarter, its Energy Storage volumes rose 11%, while the average price it realized jumped 61% to $19.53 a kilogram. Adjusted EBITDA for the segment surged 229% to $723 million.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Albemarle faces persistent headwinds from weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices, and rising supply-chain costs. Zacks view: Underperform.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating; supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.
